acceptance_oracle: For a selected profile, Activity displays durable, recent human-readable audit summaries; it never returns arbitrary audit payloads or another profile's events, and it reads the same history after reload and database reopen.
red_observation: Before implementation, GET /profiles/fixture/audit-history returned 404 in the new integration regression test.
implementation: Added a bounded profile-scoped API timeline for allowlisted profile and application audit actions, including generated resume/cover-letter summaries based on persisted document kinds.
The API returns only event IDs, event type, fixed safe summaries, timestamps and job/company context; audit payload JSON, private notes and credentials are never serialized.
Added the timeline to the Activity tab with profile-switch refresh and explicit copy that local or mock events do not establish employer receipt.
Mock confirmation is labeled fictional; non-mock CONFIRMED rows are omitted because a local state alone is not employer receipt evidence. No external submission behavior was added.
validated_coverage: The profile-owned events PROFILE_SAVED, MATCHES_RECALCULATED and allowlisted SETTING_CHANGED can appear as safe summaries.

The application-owned events DOCUMENTS_PREPARED, application tracking notes/status, answer export, queued/started/failed states and fictional mock confirmation are mapped only when matching append-only audit rows exist; generated-document labels derive from durable document records.

Other stored audit actions are excluded by query allowlists. Existing emitters do not yet provide profile-linked JOB_DISCOVERED, COMPANY_DISCOVERED, COMPANY_SOURCE_ENROLLED, JOB_MERGED, general SETTING_CHANGED, or a truthful real APPLICATION_SUBMITTED event history. These required event families remain incomplete; issue #177 stays OPEN/PARTIAL.

validation.details: TypeScript check and Vite production build completed.

browser_evidence.database: Temporary SQLite fixture database; profile-owned audit history was read after Store reopen.
browser_evidence.network: Browser requests were restricted to isolated loopback API; no external requests observed.
verified: The Activity tab renders profile audit summaries and reloads persisted history.
Switching profiles loads only the newly selected profile's events.
Raw audit payload values and other-profile event identifiers are absent from returned/rendered history.
Application/job tracking browser regression continues to pass.
